item.title: Planning a day trip to Chimgan
item.context_text: You and three friends from your English course want to go to the Chimgan mountains near Tashkent on Saturday. One friend, Tom, is a teacher from Canada. You are making the plan in a group chat.
item.objective_text: Read the tour advert, understand your friend's voice message, and write the plan in the group chat.
item.target_grammar: going to and will for plans and decisions (We're going to leave at 7. I'll bring water.)
item.cultural_note: In the mountains the weather can change quickly, even in summer. Friends usually share food on a trip like this, so it is polite to say what you will bring.
success_conditions: Find the price, the time and what is included
Understand what your friend can and can't do
Write the plan: time, place and what to bring

children.title: Read the tour advert
children.instructions: Your friend sends this advert to the group. Read it. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
MOUNTAIN DAY TRIP – EVERY SATURDAY
Leave: 7:30 am from the car park near Buyuk Ipak Yoli metro station
Back in Tashkent: about 7 pm
Price: 250,000 sum per person (bus and guide)
The cable car ticket is not in the price.
Bring: water, snacks, comfortable shoes and a warm jacket.

questions.prompt: Where does the bus leave from?
options: A car park near a metro station
questions.explanation: "from the car park near Buyuk Ipak Yoli metro station".

questions.prompt: What is not in the price?
questions.explanation: "The cable car ticket is not in the price."

children.title: Listen to Tom's voice message
children.instructions: Tom sends a voice message to the group. Listen. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text: Hey everyone, it's Tom. Saturday sounds great! But 7:30 is a bit early for me, because I don't live near that metro station. Can we meet at seven at the station, and walk to the car park together? Oh, and I'm going to bring a big bag of apples and some bread. Can someone bring tea? It's going to be cold at the top.

questions.prompt: What does Tom want to do?
options: Meet at seven at the metro station
Take a taxi to the mountains
questions.explanation: "Can we meet at seven at the station, and walk to the car park together?"

questions.prompt: What is Tom going to bring?
questions.explanation: "I'm going to bring a big bag of apples and some bread."

children.title: Write the plan
children.instructions: Write a message to the group. Agree a time and meeting place, say what you will bring, and remind everyone about one thing from the advert.
children.prompt_text: Group chat: Saturday trip to the mountains
children.goal: Write a clear plan for the trip.

points.label: give the time and meeting place
remind about something from the advert

children.model_answer: Hi all! OK, let's meet at 7:00 at Buyuk Ipak Yoli metro station, like Tom said. Then we'll walk to the car park together. I'll bring a big thermos of tea. Don't forget a warm jacket and comfortable shoes, and bring some money for the cable car!
